android_mechanism: All list-row content (drawables/previews) eagerly prepared instead of only bound/visible rows
bug_description: The main article list and card grid render store.articles with plain ForEach. Opening a feed or scrolling loads pages of articles (limit grows with 'load more'), and every accumulated article row/card — including off-screen ones — is built eagerly, with per-card context menus bound, slowing list display and paging in large feeds.
fix_summary: Both the list and grid render via LazyForEach over an IDataSource kept in sync with the store, so rows are created on demand as they enter the viewport.
trigger_steps: Subscribe to feeds with many articles (or import an OPML with large feeds) so a category holds several hundred articles.
Start hitrace capture (categories: ace, app, sched).
Open the 全部文章 view, trigger load-more 5 times, then scroll through the list.
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: Count of article card component builds during open + load-more + scroll (ace trace), first-render latency after open, and dropped frames while scrolling.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed builds every accumulated article (hundreds) eagerly; fixed builds only viewport rows. unfixed first-render and scroll jank measurably worse.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 40 ace app sched graphic -o /data/local/tmp/sr_artlist.chtrace
